svg.title: Exact expected-loss comparison of SGD learning-rate schedules

cc:Work.dc:title: Exact expected-loss comparison of SGD learning-rate schedules
cc:Work.dc:description: Scalar quadratic with unit noise variance, unit initial second moment, and 100 updates. Exact optimum compared with independently tuned linear, cosine, and constant schedules. Both vertical axes are logarithmic. No sampled training data.
